subject: FoxBridge integration legal & delivery alignment
messages:
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
To: Sasha Liu <sasha.liu@foxbridge.com>, Oliver Grant <oliver.grant@foxbridge.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 29 Nov 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: FoxBridge integration legal & delivery alignment

Hi Sasha / Oliver —

Thanks again for the demo last week. Per our discussion, I’m attaching the latest SOW (v3) and our proposed DPA. I’ve also attached a short redline summary where we pulled out the items we think will affect schedule or procurement. Key items to call out: 

- Data residency: FoxBridge asked for EU-only storage for a subset of telemetry (see DPA §4). Need clarity on whether the customer will accept our Dedicated/private offering or if they require full SaaS segregation.
- Liability cap: FoxBridge legal proposed a per-incident cap; our standard is aggregate.
- Support SLA & escalation: proposed 24/7 P1 for Platinum integrations — want to confirm whether FoxBridge expects 1-hour SLAs or can accept business-hours first response.
- Milestones & acceptance criteria: SOW currently splits delivery into three milestone payments tied to integration test sign-off. Marissa — please weigh in if you want to move any milestones earlier.

Proposed next steps: 
1) Legal sync (30–45m) to walk redlines — options Tue/Wed next week (Nov 30 / Dec 1) between 10:00–13:00 PT.
2) Procurement checklist to follow (Vanessa will own).
3) If we can align on DPA carveouts quickly, we can start work on the integration kickoff the week of Dec 7.

Attachments: FoxBridge_SOW_v3.docx (SOW with inline comments), DPA_FoxBridge_v2.pdf, FoxBridge_Redline_Summary_v1.xlsx

Thanks,
Ben
Ben Carter
Senior Alliances Manager | Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0123

From: Sasha Liu <sasha.liu@foxbridge.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Cc: Oliver Grant <oliver.grant@foxbridge.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 29 Nov 2026 11:03:00 -0500
Subject: Re: FoxBridge integration legal & delivery alignment

Ben —

Thanks for sending. Quick read-through and some initial positions from our legal team (attached as FB_DPA_comments.pdf):

- Data residency: We need an EU-only storage carveout for telemetry tied to EU customers. FoxBridge is willing to accept a hybrid approach if you can guarantee logical segregation and contractual commitments for residency for that subset.
- Liability: We’re pushing for a per-incident cap at 2x ARR for the integration. Open to compromise but cannot accept unlimited exposure.
- Subprocessors: request a prior notice period and the ability to approve high-risk subprocessors (security-sensitive).

We’re happy to jump on a call Tue Dec 1 at 11:00 PT — Sasha + Oliver + FoxBridge legal (in-house counsel) will be on. Can you confirm the calendar invite?

Attachment: FB_DPA_comments.pdf (high-level redline and commentary)

Regards,
Sasha Liu
Head of Strategic Partnerships | FoxBridge Systems
Sasha.Liu@foxbridge.com

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Sasha Liu <sasha.liu@foxbridge.com>
Cc: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 30 Nov 2026 08:45:00 -0800
Subject: Re: FoxBridge integration legal & delivery alignment

Adding a couple of delivery-side notes so legal has context: 

- Scope: The SOW currently includes connector build + two custom parsers + end-to-end tests. If FoxBridge wants EU-only telemetry for a subset of customers, that will change the deployment matrix and add one milestone for environment validation. That would likely shift the second milestone by ~2 weeks.
- Pricing: Given the extra validation, I recommend we hold the original price but move 10% of the second milestone to a post-go-live validation fee to cover the environment gating. Ben — is that acceptable from a commercial standpoint?
- Acceptance criteria: please see the excerpt below (pulled from SOW v3):

--- Forwarded excerpt from FoxBridge_SOW_v3.docx ---
Deliverable: Integration connector + two parsers
Acceptance: Successful ingest of sample datasets (3 customers) in target environment; 95% parsing accuracy measured across sample set; operations runbook delivered.
--- end excerpt ---

I’ll be on the Dec 1 call and can walk the milestone implications.

Thanks,
Marissa Cole
Principal Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.com

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
To: Sasha Liu <sasha.liu@foxbridge.com>, Oliver Grant <oliver.grant@foxbridge.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 1 Dec 2026 15:20:00 -0800
Subject: Re: FoxBridge integration legal & delivery alignment

Thanks all — calendar invite sent for Tue Dec 1 at 11:00 PT (see invite). Quick action items ahead of the call: 

- Sasha / FoxBridge legal: flag 2–3 non-starters in the DPA PDF so we can prioritize on the call (Sasha).
- Redwood legal (cc’d separately) to propose a middle-ground liability cap language if possible — I’ll loop in our GC offline.
- Marissa: prepare a short slide on milestone impact and delta cost (if any).
- Vanessa: procurement checklist + PO template to share after call.

If we can resolve the residency carve and a single liability compromise, we can keep the current target kickoff week of Dec 7. Otherwise, we’ll need to push to mid-December.

Best,
Ben

From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com>
To: Sasha Liu <sasha.liu@foxbridge.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 2 Dec 2026 10:05:00 -0800
Subject: Re: FoxBridge integration legal & delivery alignment

Sasha / team —

Thanks for the call yesterday. Per discussion, I’m attaching our procurement checklist and a standard PO template to speed procurement: procurement_checklist.pdf, PO_template.docx. Main procurement notes: 

- Net 45 is our standard for partnerships of this size; we can discuss Net 30 if FoxBridge procurement needs it for cashflow.
- For EU residency carveouts, please provide a short appendix that defines the affected telemetry fields and customers so our ops team can scope environment segregation.
- DocuSign: we prefer to execute the MSA + DPA via DocuSign; please confirm the authorized signatory for FoxBridge and whether legal needs a wet-sign option.

Next steps: please loop in procurement@foxbridge.com and cc me so we can exchange PO/ILNs.

Attachments: procurement_checklist.pdf, PO_template.docx

Regards,
Vanessa Ortiz
Senior Manager, Strategic Procurement | Redwood Inference
vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com
